paragraphs: I'm Chase Farrant. I work in automation, cloud infrastructure, and backend software development. My work includes deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, and backend APIs.
I like systems that are straightforward to operate and change. Most of my projects start with something I want to automate, understand, or fix.
outsideWork: Outside work, I spend time on electronics, home renovation, and projects around the farm. I grew up skiing and riding dirt bikes, and later rebuilt the three bikes I rode as a kid. I also played guitar in Catch Amy during college.
